This scene:
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候：在古代
- 但是城市有才两个学校：这个城市，只有

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，The original repeats the idea of “time”: 古代 already names a historical time period. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 有才：只有，To express that the city has only two schools, use 只有 before the number; 有才 does not form this “only” meaning here. [teacher rule: zhiyou_caiyou]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子：一个叫孟子的男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国，Introduce the main character with his name in the first mention rather than naming him only in the following sentence. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他很喜欢他的城市：孟子很喜欢自己的城市，Use 自己的 when the city belongs to the same person as the subject, making the possession explicit. [teacher rule: ziji_possessor]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly formed under the teacher's rule.
有才 means “have talent” here, while 只有 correctly expresses that there are only two schools.
The teacher's first-mention rule requires introducing the main character with his name.
他的城市 is already clear here and is acceptable; 自己的 is possible but not required.
